Exceptional 4 Bedroom Detached Family Residence with Detached Garage & Sauna in the Heart of Leitrim Village

Presented in superb condition throughout, this impressive detached family home offers spacious and beautifully maintained accommodation in one of Leitrim Village’s most sought-after residential settings. Ideally located within walking distance of all local amenities and just moments from the scenic River Shannon, this property combines modern family living with the charm and tranquillity of village life.

Extending to generous proportions, the accommodation comprises a bright and welcoming entrance hallway, a comfortable living room with feature fireplace, a separate playroom/family room, and a spacious kitchen/dining area ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. A utility room and downstairs bathroom complete the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property boasts four well-appointed bedrooms, two of which benefit from ensuite bathrooms, offering excellent comfort and privacy for family and guests alike. The main family bathroom is finished to a high standard.

Externally, the property enjoys ample parking, landscaped surroundings, and the added benefit of a detached garage and private sauna — perfect for relaxation and additional storage or hobby space.

This outstanding home is ideally suited to growing families or anyone seeking a quality residence in a vibrant village setting close to schools, shops, restaurants, sporting facilities, and the beautiful River Shannon with its many leisure amenities.

Viewing of this exceptional property is highly recommended.
